objective: Review the defined built-binary parser-behavior boundary for the repaired Verilator native option parser overlay patch and decide whether the next gate may execute that parser-only smoke without claiming sidecar execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, or automatic allocation.

review_decision.weakest_point: The accepted boundary can observe only built-binary option parsing and notify diagnostics through exit code and stderr on a generated trivial lint-only RTL input. It cannot observe V3Options accessor values directly, sidecar handoff, runtime ABI behavior, simulation execution, timing, arbitrary filelist planning, dependency inference, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing.
accepted_because: the source definition is downstream of accepted descriptor/apply/location sanity and accepted verilator_bin compile/link evidence for the repaired overlay patch
the selected validation kind is limited to a built Verilator binary option-parse-and-notify smoke
the positive cases cover the two expanded spellings needed for state-parallel and repeated-step shape classes
the rejection cases cover unknown accelerator, missing accelerator, missing shape halves, and zero counts without broadening into runtime behavior
the generated trivial RTL input is sufficient for parser-only lint-mode execution and is explicitly not source of truth
reusing the generated built binary is acceptable only when the source build gate remains the reproducible authority; otherwise the run gate must regenerate an equivalent build from recorded commands
strict std::atoi suffix behavior remains a known deferred gap rather than a parser-quality claim

required_next_gate.name: run_verilator_native_option_parser_overlay_patch_parser_behavior_gate
must_run_or_record: locate the existing generated verilator_bin or regenerate an equivalent build from the source build-run gate commands
write the generated trivial RTL input under artifacts/verilator_native_option_parser_overlay_patch_parser_behavior/
run the two accepted positive expanded option cases through the built binary in lint-only mode
run the required rejection cases through the built binary and capture exit code plus expected stderr substrings
record whether the generated built binary was reused or regenerated
record all command exit codes and diagnostics without storing generated artifacts or reports as source of truth
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
strict integer-token parsing for std::atoi suffix inputs
review_after_run_must_decide: whether all required positive and rejection cases passed
whether generated-binary reuse was acceptable or regeneration was needed
whether negative-count behavior should be promoted into a required hardening case
whether std::atoi suffix behavior should remain deferred or block further native-parser claims

non_claims: not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a landed upstream Verilator patch
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
